title: otel_tracing plugin config
description: The `config` object of an enabled `otel_tracing` plugin, generated from ferrum-edge/ferrum-edge openapi.yaml at v0.9.21 (f9915358c8032214f4034a17c28cdf72d14006c3), component OtelTracingConfig and every component it references. Do not edit: run ci/plugin_config_schemas.py. This is Edge's own configuration schema, governed by Edge's support policy (docs/versioning.md); the plugin catalog records when Edge requires it.

OtelTracingConfig.description: Plugin: otel_tracing — W3C Trace Context propagation and OTLP/HTTP JSON span export. This plugin has no exporter selector and always exports OTLP; Zipkin, Datadog, and Lightstep span export is configured through mesh Telemetry providers on workload_metrics. Trace-context trust defaults to untrusted (fail-closed). Parent sampling is honored; root sampling defaults to always_on. Server span names use low-cardinality proxy/route identifiers. Every configured property is non-null; omit optional properties instead of sending null. Configured strings are trimmed before use, so a whitespace-only value is rejected, and the enum-valued properties are accepted case-insensitively.

endpoint.description: OTLP/HTTP collector endpoint. Omit for propagation-only mode. Must be an http or https URL with a non-empty host. URL userinfo is rejected; path/query credentials are redacted in diagnostics. An http:// URL is admitted only to a loopback IP literal written as a dotted-quad 127.d.d.d or [::1] unless allow_plaintext is true.

allow_plaintext.description: Admit an http:// endpoint whose host is not a loopback IP literal. Spans and any `authorization` / `headers` credential then cross the network in clear.

service_name.description: Service name in spans and resource attributes. Trimmed before use and rejected when blank. Retained as configured, not bounded by max_attribute_bytes.

deployment_environment.description: deployment.environment resource attribute. Trimmed before use and rejected when blank. Retained as configured, not bounded by max_attribute_bytes.

generate_trace_id.description: Generate trace IDs for requests without a usable incoming traceparent

headers.description: Custom HTTP headers sent with OTLP exports (values treated as secrets). Field names must be HTTP tokens and values must be legal HTTP header values; both are rejected at construction otherwise. Names are case-insensitive: two keys differing only in case are rejected, as are the exporter-managed Content-Type, Content-Length, Content-Encoding, Transfer-Encoding, and Host, and Authorization when `authorization` is set.

authorization.description: Authorization header value for OTLP exports (secret). Trimmed before use, rejected when blank, and rejected when it is not a legal HTTP header value — including in propagation-only mode. Diagnostics for a rejected value name the field and the expected type only, never the value.

flush_interval_ms.description: Max delay before flushing a partial batch

buffer_capacity.description: Capacity of the exporter's span queue; new spans are dropped when that queue is full. The flush worker holds its in-flight batch outside this queue, so total pending spans can reach buffer_capacity + batch_size. Aggregate retention is bounded by buffer_max_bytes and the process observability byte ceiling.

buffer_max_bytes.description: Aggregate queued span byte budget before new spans are dropped

max_attribute_bytes.description: Max retained bytes per request-derived string span attribute (consumer, user agent, route, namespace, addresses, url.path, mesh attributes). Configured identity — service_name and deployment_environment, in both the span and resource attribute sets — is retained as configured.

retry_delay_ms.description: Base delay before the first retry. Subsequent retries double it with +/-25% jitter, capped at 60000 ms. A collector Retry-After header on a retryable response (delay-seconds or HTTP-date) overrides this delay for that attempt, also capped at 60000 ms. Only 429, 502, 503, and 504 are retried; every other non-success status discards the batch.

trace_context_trust.description: Whether inbound W3C parents are adopted. Canonical values are untrusted and trusted; the value is trimmed and matched case-insensitively. untrusted (default) creates a fresh root and never parents under caller-chosen IDs. trusted adopts a valid lowercase W3C parent for internal/mesh propagation.

root_sampling.description: Sampling policy for locally created root traces. Canonical values are always_on, always_off, and ratio; the value is trimmed and matched case-insensitively.

root_sampling_ratio.description: Required when root_sampling=ratio; fraction of roots sampled. Rejected when set with any other root_sampling mode.

include_url_path.description: Include bounded url.path attribute (never used as span name)

compression.description: Export body compression. Canonical values are none and gzip; the value is trimmed and matched case-insensitively. gzip sends each OTLP/HTTP JSON batch with Content-Encoding gzip; when the compressed copy cannot be reserved under the process observability byte ceiling the batch is sent uncompressed.
